description: NHFLOW hydrostatic semi-implicit: 2D vertical river, q = 1 m2/s (B 60 1, log inflow B 61 2), outflow level F 62, log-law bed friction (A 519 1) and k-epsilon (A 560 1) with 10 sigma layers; vertical diffusion and bed friction implicit in the column operator. The steady water level does not depend on dt (dt 1 s and 10 s agree to 0.3 mm) and is within 3 cm of the explicit hydrostatic NHFLOW.
